{"id":1865787601,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1766751218,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"19 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1865787601/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"14.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        int l = 0;\n        int ans = INT_MIN;\n        unordered_map<char,int>mp;\n        int r = 0;\n\n        while(r < s.size())\n        {\n            if(mp.count(s[r]))\n            {\n                mp.erase(s[l]);\n                l++;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                mp[s[r]]++;\n                ans = max(ans , r - l + 1);\n                r++;\n            }\n        }\n    return ans == INT_MIN ? 0 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1407}
